body:
_Migrated from issue #897, filed 2026-07-14._

A user who sets `HARDCOVER_TOKEN` and wants to confirm it works sees nothing on the admin page, because the field, the env-token note, and the token-status block all sit inside the section that the `Enable Hardcover Sync` checkbox collapses — and that checkbox is off by default (`cps/config_sql.py:106`).

`cps/templates/config_edit.html:275` gates `data-related="hardcover-settings"` (`:278`), which contains:
- the Hardcover API Key field (`:280-281`)
- the env-token note (`:283-285`)
- the token status block (`:286-303`)

So the status only appears to someone who has already enabled sync — not to someone trying to work out whether their token is set. Token configuration is not sync configuration; it should not be gated behind a sync toggle.

This also means #838 is only half-delivered: the status block shipped, but it is unreachable in the default state.

It also makes two of our own claims over-stated — the v4.1.9 close-out on #743 and `README.md:439` both say the admin page shows a note when an environment token is active, which holds only once sync is enabled.

Suggested fix: move the token field, note, and status out of the `data-related` div.

Credit: @KucharczykL (#873).
title: Hardcover token status + env-token note are hidden until "Enable Hardcover Sync" is on
